messages:
morgan: FYI I opened a PR that changes the audit_log schema + a small KMS keyref update. Need security eyes before I merge — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4287 :wave:

morgan: Summary: adding event_type enum, new metadata JSONB field, and a migration that backfills legacy entries. Also swapped some hardcoded key ids to lookups behind KMS refs.

devon: ping @lina @sara — this touches the event ingestion path, can you check for any policy blockers? :eyes:

lina: I'll take a look in a bit. main concern will be: does the metadata JSONB open us to PII leaks in logs?

morgan: good call. intentionally kept metadata to minimal keys: {user_id (hashed), request_id, service}. added validation in the ingestion layer to strip any freeform text. snippet: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"user_id":{"type":"string"},"request_id":{"type":"string"},"service":{"type":"string"}},"additionalProperties":false}```

sara: can you show the migration script? I want to confirm it's reversible and respects our retention policy.

morgan: migration is idempotent — uses upsert and a short txn window. snippet: ```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE audit_log ADD COLUMN metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
UPDATE audit_log SET metadata = jsonb_build_object('service', coalesce(service, 'unknown')) WHERE metadata = '{}'::jsonb;
COMMIT;
```

morgan: also added a feature flag so rollout can be toggled per region (feature: audit_schema_v2). planning canary in us-west-2 then global after 24h.

jamal: @morgan — KMS change: did you update key rotation policy ref in the config? we need to ensure HSM-backed keys are still used for production tenant tokens.

morgan: yes — replaced hardcoded key id with call to keystore.get_active_key(tenant_id). left the default to the existing HSM alias.

secops-bot: CI check: security-scan passed with 0 HIGH findings. See report: https://ci.redwood/scan/4287

ci-bot: Build: ✅ unit + integration passed on branch auditlog-schema. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/builds/4287

lina: looked through code — small nit in validation but nothing blocking. main ask: add a short test asserting extra fields are rejected.

sara: migration looks OK to me, but @jamal should confirm KMS/HSM alignment for prod keys. once jamal + lina sign off, we can merge behind the feature flag. :thumbsup:

jamal: checking the keystore change now. If it stays HSM alias for default, I'm fine. Will post approval here once confirmed.

morgan: thanks all — tagging for followups: please add approvals in the PR. I'll hold merge until both security approvals and jamal's KMS confirmation.

jamal: Confirmed — default keystore alias resolves to HSM-backed key in prod. LGTM from infra/KMS side.

lina: added a tiny test and pushed. also added a comment with the threat-model note. LGTM from sec.

sara: Approved. you can merge behind feature flag after internal QA. :white_check_mark:
